rationale: C01 is the strongest plausible drafting template because it predates the child by four months and reproduces nearly the entire directive in the same sequence, including the distinctive multi-carrier formulation using a conference committee and an incorporated List A. The child adapts that machinery to the New York Harbor carriers and adds a separate List B for the labor organizations. C07 is especially close in the underlying New York harbor parties, but its carrier names are embedded in the operative text rather than incorporated through attached lists. C08 also uses the attached-list device, but is less closely aligned in time and target.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a dispute exists between certain carriers represented by the New York Harbor Carriers' Conference Committee, designated in List A attached hereto and hereby made a part hereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a dispute exists between the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad Company and other carriers represented by the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, designated in List A attached hereto and hereby made a part hereof
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel formulation for a multi-carrier dispute, with carriers represented by a named conference committee and incorporated through an attached List A.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.explanation: Identical second recital in the same position.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: no change, except by agreement, shall be made by carriers represented by the New York Harbor Carriers' Conference Committee, or by their employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose
shared_material.parent_excerpt: no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad Company or any other carrier represented by the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, or by their employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same statutory standstill provision and adapts the represented-carrier language to the new committee and dispute.
